description: Phase 6 feedback. Which outcomes a client may report (the rest are recorded by the server where they happen), and the rules Michael uses to propose a preference change from them. services/intelligence/app/feedback/proposals.py applies the rules; src/lib/preference-proposals.ts shows and applies an accepted change. A proposal is never applied without the user pressing Apply, and a decision (accept or dismiss) silences that proposal for suppressDays and resets its evidence.
